entries.Original: Join the Discord
entries.Translated: 加入不和谐

entries.Original: Get help, report bugs, share ideas and hear about updates first.
entries.Translated: 获取帮助，报告 bug，分享想法，并先听取更新。

entries.Original: View on GitHub
entries.Translated: 在 GitHub 上查看

entries.Original: Browse the source code and every release.
entries.Translated: 浏览源代码和每个版本。

entries.Original: A little reminder
entries.Translated: 一个小提醒

entries.Original: Did you know?
entries.Translated: 你知道吗？

entries.Original: Words to live by
entries.Translated: 活下去的话语

entries.Original: Just for fun
entries.Translated: 只是为了好玩

entries.Original: Been at it a while? Roll your shoulders and take one slow breath.
entries.Translated: 做了一会儿了吗？转动肩膀，慢慢地深呼吸。

entries.Original: Hydration check. When did you last drink some water?
entries.Translated: 水分检查。你最后一次喝水是什么时候？

entries.Original: Blink a few times and let your eyes rest for a moment.
entries.Translated: 眨几下眼睛，让眼睛休息一会儿。

entries.Original: Stand up, stretch, and shake out your hands. Future you says thanks.
entries.Translated: 站起来，伸个懒腰，然后挥挥手。未来，你要说声谢谢。

entries.Original: Sit up and settle in comfortably. Your back will thank you later.
entries.Translated: 坐起来，舒服点。你的背待会儿会感谢你的。

entries.Original: Remember to eat something today. You matter more than any score.
entries.Translated: 记得今天吃点东西。你比任何分数都重要。

entries.Original: Eyes feel tired? Look at something far away for twenty seconds.
entries.Translated: 眼睛累了吗？看着远处的某个东西二十秒。

entries.Original: Whatever you're chasing, you're allowed to take a break whenever.
entries.Translated: 无论你在追求什么，你都可以随时休息。

entries.Original: You're doing great. Be a little kinder to yourself today.
entries.Translated: 你做得很好。今天对自己好一点。

entries.Original: A glass of water and a quick stretch can reset a long session.
entries.Translated: 一杯水和一个快速的伸展可以重置一个长时间的会话。

entries.Original: Unclench your jaw and drop your shoulders. There you go.
entries.Translated: 松开下巴，放松肩膀。就是这样。

entries.Original: Rest is part of the journey too. Step away whenever you need to.
entries.Translated: 休息也是旅程的一部分。需要的时候随时可以离开。

entries.Original: Honey never spoils. Jars over 3,000 years old have been found still edible.
entries.Translated: 蜂蜜永远不会腐烂。已经发现了超过 3000 年历史的罐子仍然可以食用。

entries.Original: Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.
entries.Translated: 章鱼有三颗心脏和蓝色的血液。

entries.Original: A day on Venus is longer than a whole year on Venus.
entries.Translated: 金星上的一天比金星上的一整年还要长。

entries.Original: Bananas are berries, but strawberries aren't.
entries.Translated: 香蕉是浆果，但草莓不是。

entries.Original: There are more possible chess games than atoms in the observable universe.
entries.Translated: 在可观测宇宙中，可能的棋局比原子还要多。

entries.Original: Sharks have been around longer than trees have.
entries.Translated: 鲨鱼存在的时间比树木还要长。

entries.Original: A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.
entries.Translated: 一群火烈鸟被称为火焰鸟。

entries.Original: Honeybees can recognize individual human faces.
entries.Translated: 蜜蜂能够识别单个人脸。

entries.Original: Wombat droppings are cube shaped.
entries.Translated: 袋熊粪便呈立方体形状。

entries.Original: The Eiffel Tower can grow over 15 cm taller on a hot day.
entries.Translated: 在炎热的天气里，艾菲尔铁塔可以长高超过 15 厘米。

entries.Original: Hot water can sometimes freeze faster than cold water.
entries.Translated: 热水有时比冷水结冰更快。

entries.Original: A bolt of lightning is roughly five times hotter than the surface of the Sun.
entries.Translated: 闪电的温度大约是太阳表面温度的五倍。

entries.Original: Done is better than perfect. You can always polish later.
entries.Translated: 完成比完美更重要。你可以以后再润色。

entries.Original: Small steps every day add up to surprising distances.
entries.Translated: 每天小小的步伐累积起来，会形成惊人的距离。

entries.Original: Comparison is the thief of joy. Run your own race.
entries.Translated: 比较是偷走快乐的小偷。自己去赛跑吧。

entries.Original: Progress, not perfection.
entries.Translated: 进步，而非完美。

entries.Original: You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
entries.Translated: 你不必一开始就很出色，但你必须开始变得出色。

entries.Original: Be patient with yourself. Growth takes time.
entries.Translated: 对自己要有耐心。成长需要时间。

entries.Original: The best time to begin was yesterday. The second best is right now.
entries.Translated: 最好的开始时机是昨天。第二好的是现在。

entries.Original: Celebrate the small wins. They count too.
entries.Translated: 庆祝那些小小的胜利吧。它们也很重要。

entries.Original: Slow progress is still progress.
entries.Translated: 缓慢的进步仍然是进步。

entries.Original: Your only real competition is who you were yesterday.
entries.Translated: 你唯一真正的竞争对手是昨天的你。

entries.Original: Why don't scientists trust atoms? Because they make up everything.
entries.Translated: 为什么科学家不相信原子？因为它们构成了一切。

entries.Original: I would tell you a chemistry joke, but I know I wouldn't get a reaction.
entries.Translated: 我想给你讲个化学笑话，但我知道你不会有什么反应。

entries.Original: Why did the scarecrow win an award? He was outstanding in his field.
entries.Translated: 稻草人为什么会获奖？他在自己的领域很出色。

entries.Original: I'm reading a book about anti-gravity. It's impossible to put down.
entries.Translated: 我正在读一本关于反重力的书。简直无法放下。

entries.Original: Why don't skeletons fight each other? They don't have the guts.
entries.Translated: 为什么骷髅不互相残杀？他们没有那个胆量。

entries.Original: What do you call fake spaghetti? An impasta.
entries.Translated: 你说假意大利面是什么？面团。

entries.Original: Why did the bicycle fall over? It was two tired.
entries.Translated: 为什么自行车倒下了？两个人累了。

entries.Original: What do you call cheese that isn't yours? Nacho cheese.
entries.Translated: 你管不属于自己的奶酪叫什么？纳乔奶酪。

entries.Original: I'm on a seafood diet. I see food, and I eat it.
entries.Translated: 我正在进行海鲜饮食。我看到食物就吃。

entries.Original: I only know 25 letters of the alphabet. I don't know y.
entries.Translated: 我只认识 25 个字母。我不认识你。
